===== C:\Users\ss\Documents\PRESENTATION\projet\README.md =====

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

import React from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import '@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css';

// Layout
import MainLayout from './layout/MainLayout';

// Pages
import Home from './pages/Home';
import Explore from './pages/Explore';
import Trending from './pages/Trending';
import News from './pages/News';
import Artists from './pages/Artists';
import Groups from './pages/Groups';
import Events from './pages/Events';
import Videos from './pages/Videos';
import Community from './pages/Community';
import Messages from './pages/Messages';

import CreatePost from './pages/CreatePost';
import PostDetails from './pages/PostDetails';
import Search from './pages/Search';
import Communities from './pages/Communities';
import Settings from './pages/Settings';
import Splash from './pages/Splash';

// Styles
import './styles/global.css';
import './styles/dark.css';
import './styles/MainLayout.css';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = React.useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    return saved ? saved === 'dark' : false;
  });

  React.useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
  }, [isDark]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setIsDark(!isDark);
  };

  return (
    <Router>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/auth" element={<Auth />} />
        <Route path="/" element={<MainLayout toggleTheme={toggleTheme} isDark={isDark} />}>
          <Route index element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="explore" element={<Explore />} />
          <Route path="trending" element={<Trending />} />
          <Route path="news" element={<News />} />
          <Route path="artists" element={<Artists />} />
          <Route path="groups" element={<Groups />} />
          <Route path="events" element={<Events />} />
          <Route path="videos" element={<Videos />} />
          <Route path="community" element={<Community />} />

          <Route path="notifications" element={<Notifications />} />
          <Route path="profile" element={<Profile />} />

          <Route path="communities" element={<Communities />} />
          <Route path="settings" element={<Settings />} />
        </Route>
        <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
      </Routes>
    </Router>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import Post from './Post';
import type { PostData } from './Post';
import '../styles/Feed.css';

interface FeedProps {
  posts: PostData[];
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  emptyMessage?: string;
}

const Feed: React.FC<FeedProps> = ({
  posts,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onShare,
  loading = false,
  emptyMessage = 'No posts to display',
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-loading">
        <div className="feed-loading-spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading posts...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-empty">
        <i className="fas fa-inbox"></i>
        <h3>{emptyMessage}</h3>
        <p>Check back later for updates from the K-Pop community!</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="feed">
      {posts.map(post => (
        <Post
          key={post.id}
          post={post}
          onLike={onLike}
          onComment={onComment}
          onShare={onShare}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Feed;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import Header from './Header';
import Sidebar from './Sidebar';
import RightSidebar from './RightSidebar';

interface LayoutProps {
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  isDark: boolean;
}

const Layout: React.FC<LayoutProps> = ({ toggleTheme, isDark }) => {
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();

  const toggleMobileMenu = () => {
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(!isMobileMenuOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = !isMobileMenuOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  };

  // RightSidebar tsy aseho afa-tsy ao amin'ny Home (/) ihany
  const showRightSidebar = location.pathname === '/';

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
  }, [location]);

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <Header 
        toggleTheme={toggleTheme} 
        isDark={isDark}
        onToggleMobileMenu={toggleMobileMenu}
        isMobileMenuOpen={isMobileMenuOpen}
      />
      <div className="app-body">
        <Sidebar isOpen={isMobileMenuOpen} onClose={toggleMobileMenu} />
        <main className="app-main">
          <div className="app-content-wrapper">
            <Outlet />
          </div>
        </main>
        {showRightSidebar && <RightSidebar />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Layout;

File: components\SearchBar.tsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/SearchBar.css';

interface SearchBarProps {
  placeholder?: string;
  onSearch: (query: string) => void;
  initialValue?: string;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}

const SearchBar: React.FC<SearchBarProps> = ({
  placeholder = 'Search artists, groups, songs...',
  onSearch,
  initialValue = '',
  autoFocus = false,
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialValue);
  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = useState(false);

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    onSearch(value);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setQuery('');
    onSearch('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (query.trim()) {
      onSearch(query.trim());
    }
  };

  return (
    <form 
      className={`search-bar ${isFocused ? 'focused' : ''}`}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      role="search"
      aria-label="Barre de recherche"
    >
      <i className="fas fa-search search-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <input
        type="text"
        className="search-input"
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={query}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onFocus={() => setIsFocused(true)}
        onBlur={() => setIsFocused(false)}
        autoFocus={autoFocus}
        aria-label="Rechercher des artistes, groupes, chansons"
      />
      {query && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="search-clear"
          onClick={handleClear}
          aria-label="Effacer la recherche"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-times-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
      )}
      <button 
        type="submit" 
        className="search-submit"
        aria-label="Lancer la recherche"
      >
        <i className="fas fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};

export default SearchBar;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/Sidebar.css';

interface SidebarProps {
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

interface SidebarItem {
  to: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
}

interface TrendingItem {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  posts: number;
}

const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({ isOpen = false, onClose }) => {
  const [trendingItems] = useState<TrendingItem[]>([
    { id: 1, title: 'BTS Jimin Solo Album', category: 'Music', posts: 1245 },
    { id: 2, title: 'BLACKPINK World Tour', category: 'Events', posts: 876 },
    { id: 3, title: 'NewJeans Comeback', category: 'News', posts: 543 },
    { id: 4, title: 'Stray Kids Win Award', category: 'Awards', posts: 321 },
    { id: 5, title: 'TWICE 10th Anniversary', category: 'Celebration', posts: 234 },
  ]);

  const sidebarItems: SidebarItem[] = [
    { to: '/', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
    { to: '/trending', label: 'Trending', icon: 'fire' },
    { to: '/news', label: 'News', icon: 'newspaper' },
    { to: '/artists', label: 'Artists', icon: 'microphone' },
    { to: '/groups', label: 'Groups', icon: 'users' },
    { to: '/events', label: 'Events', icon: 'calendar-alt' },
    { to: '/videos', label: 'Videos', icon: 'video' },
    { to: '/community', label: 'Community', icon: 'comments' },
  ];

  const handleLinkClick = () => {
    if (onClose) {
      onClose();
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="sidebar-overlay" onClick={onClose} />
      )}
      
      <aside className={`sidebar ${isOpen ? 'open' : ''}`}>
        {/* ============================================================
            NAVIGATION PRINCIPALE
            ============================================================ */}
        <nav className="sidebar-nav">
          {sidebarItems.map((item) => (
            <NavLink
              key={item.to}
              to={item.to}
              className={({ isActive }) => 
                `sidebar-nav-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`
              }
              onClick={handleLinkClick}
              end
            >
              <i className={`fas fa-${item.icon}`} aria-hidden="true"></i>
              <span className="nav-label">{item.label}</span>
            </NavLink>
          ))}
        </nav>

        {/* ============================================================
            TRENDING - DANS LA SIDEBAR GAUCHE (LEFT)
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="sidebar-trending">
          <div className="sidebar-trending-header">
            <h4 className="sidebar-trending-title">
              <i className="fas fa-fire" style={{ color: '#FF6B6B' }}></i> 
              <span>Trending</span>
            </h4>
            <NavLink to="/trending" className="sidebar-trending-seeall" onClick={handleLinkClick}>
              See all
            </NavLink>
          </div>
          
          <div className="sidebar-trending-list">
            {trendingItems.map((item, index) => (
              <NavLink 
                key={item.id} 
                to={`/trending/${item.id}`}
                className="sidebar-trending-item"
                onClick={handleLinkClick}
              >
                <span className={`sidebar-trending-rank rank-${index + 1}`}>
                  {index + 1}
                </span>
                <div className="sidebar-trending-content">
                  <span className="sidebar-trending-title-text">{item.title}</span>
                  <span className="sidebar-trending-meta">
                    {item.category} â€¢ {item.posts.toLocaleString()} posts
                  </span>
                </div>
              </NavLink>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ============================================================
            PROFIL UTILISATEUR - FOOTER
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="sidebar-footer">
          <div className="sidebar-user">
            <div className="sidebar-user-avatar">
              <span>K</span>
            </div>
            <div className="user-info">
              <span className="user-name">K-Pop Fan</span>
              <span className="user-status">Online</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

import React from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/Header.css';

interface HeaderProps {
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  isDark: boolean;
  onToggleMobileMenu: () => void;
  isMobileMenuOpen: boolean;
}

const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  toggleTheme,
  isDark,
  onToggleMobileMenu,
  isMobileMenuOpen,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = React.useState('');

  const handleSearch = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      navigate(`/explore?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery.trim())}`);
      setSearchQuery('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="header">
      <div className="header-container">
        <Link to="/" className="header-left">
          <i className="fas fa-microphone header-logo-icon"></i>
          <span className="logo-text">K-POP UNITED</span>
        </Link>

        <div className="header-center">
          <form className="search-bar" onSubmit={handleSearch}>
            <i className="fas fa-search search-icon"></i>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search K-Pop..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          </form>
        </div>

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/BottomNavigation.css';

interface BottomNavigationProps {
  currentTab: string;
  onTabChange: (tab: string) => void;
}

const BottomNavigation: React.FC<BottomNavigationProps> = ({ currentTab, onTabChange }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'home', icon: 'fa-house', label: 'Home', path: '/' },
    { id: 'explore', icon: 'fa-compass', label: 'Explore', path: '/explore' },
    { id: 'create', icon: 'fa-plus', label: '', path: '/create', isCreate: true },
    { id: 'notifications', icon: 'fa-bell', label: 'Notifications', path: '/notifications' },
    { id: 'profile', icon: 'fa-user', label: 'Profile', path: '/profile' },
  ];

  const handleTabClick = (tab: typeof tabs[0]) => {
    if (tab.isCreate) {
      navigate('/create');
    } else {
      onTabChange(tab.id);
      navigate(tab.path);
    }
  };

  return (
    <nav className="bottom-nav">
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = location.pathname === tab.path || 
          (tab.id === 'home' && location.pathname === '/');
        
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            className={`bottom-nav-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''} ${tab.isCreate ? 'create-btn' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleTabClick(tab)}
            aria-label={tab.label || 'Create post'}
          >
            {tab.isCreate ? (
              <div className="create-icon-wrapper">
                <i className={`fas ${tab.icon}`}></i>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <i className={`fas ${tab.icon}`}></i>
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom';

interface NavItem {
  to: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
}

interface NavigationProps {
  items: NavItem[];
  className?: string;
  variant?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
}

const Navigation: React.FC<NavigationProps> = ({ 
  items, 
  className = '', 
  variant = 'horizontal' 
}) => {
  return (
    <nav className={`navigation navigation-${variant} ${className}`}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <NavLink
          key={item.to}
          to={item.to}
          className={({ isActive }) => 
            `nav-link ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`
          }
          end
        >
          {item.icon && <i className={`fas fa-${item.icon}`}></i>}
          <span>{item.label}</span>
        </NavLink>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/CreatePost.css';

interface CreatePostProps {
  onPostCreated: (content: string, image?: string) => void;
}

const CreatePost: React.FC<CreatePostProps> = ({ onPostCreated }) => {
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string>('');
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (content.trim()) {
      onPostCreated(content, image || undefined);
      setContent('');
      setImage('');
      setIsExpanded(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="create-post-card">
      <div className="create-post-header" onClick={() => setIsExpanded(true)}>
        <img 
          src="https://i.pravatar.cc/40?img=11" 
          alt="User" 
          className="create-post-avatar" 
        />
        <span className="create-post-placeholder">
          What's happening in K-Pop?
        </span>
      </div>

      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="create-post-expanded animate-fade">
          <div className="create-post-input-area">
            <img 
              src="https://i.pravatar.cc/40?img=11" 
              alt="User" 
              className="create-post-avatar" 
            />
            <textarea
              className="create-post-textarea"
              placeholder="Share your K-Pop thoughts..."
              value={content}
              onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
              onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
              rows={3}
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>

          {image && (
            <div className="create-post-image-preview">
              <img src={image} alt="Preview" />
              <button 
                className="create-post-remove-image"
                onClick={() => setImage('')}
              >
                <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="create-post-actions">
            <div className="create-post-media-buttons">
              <button 
                className="create-post-media-btn"
                onClick={() => setImage('https://picsum.photos/600/400?random=' + Date.now())}
              >
                <i className="fas fa-image" style={{ color: '#4A90D9' }}></i>
                <span>Photo</span>
              </button>
              <button className="create-post-media-btn">
                <i className="fas fa-video" style={{ color: '#FF6B9D' }}></i>
                <span>Video</span>
              </button>
              <button className="create-post-media-btn">
                <i className="fas fa-music" style={{ color: '#9B59B6' }}></i>
                <span>Music</span>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="create-post-submit-actions">
              <button 
                className="create-post-cancel"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsExpanded(false);
                  setContent('');
                  setImage('');
                }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button 
                className={`create-post-submit ${content.trim() ? 'active' : ''}`}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocalStorage } from '../hooks/useLocalStorage';
import '../styles/Post.css';

// ============================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================
export interface PostData {
  id: string;
  author: {
    name: string;
    username: string;
    avatar: string;
    group: string;
  };
  content: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  likes: number;
  comments: number;
  shares: number;
  liked: boolean;
  tags: string[];
}

interface PostProps {
  post: PostData;
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
}

// ============================================================
// COMPOSANT PRINCIPAL
// ============================================================
const Post: React.FC<PostProps> = ({ post, onLike, onComment, onShare }) => {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_liked`, post.liked);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_likes`, post.likes);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (liked !== post.liked) {
      const newCount = liked ? likeCount + 1 : likeCount - 1;
      setLikeCount(Math.max(0, newCount));
    }
  }, [liked]);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string): string => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const handleLike = (): void => {
    const newLiked = !liked;
    setLiked(newLiked);
    setIsAnimating(true);
    onLike(post.id);
    setTimeout(() => setIsAnimating(false), 400);
  };

  const getInitial = (name: string): string => name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const getAvatarColor = (name: string): string => {
    const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22'];
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
      hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
    }
    return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
  };

  // Formatage des nombres (ex: 24800 â†’ 24.8K)
  const formatNumber = (num: number): string => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return num.toString();
  };

  return (
    <article className="post-card">
      {/* ============================================================
          EN-TÃŠTE - AVATAR + NOM + MÃ‰TA
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-header">
        <div
          className="post-avatar"
          style={{ background: getAvatarColor(post.author.name) }}
        >
          {getInitial(post.author.name)}
        </div>
        <div className="post-author-info">
          <span className="post-author-name">{post.author.name}</span>
          <div className="post-author-meta">
            <span className="post-group">{post.author.group}</span>
            <span className="post-time">Â· {formatTimeAgo(post.timestamp)}</span>
            <span className="post-audience">Â· <i className="fas fa-globe"></i> Public</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button className="post-options-btn" aria-label="Options">
          <i className="fas fa-ellipsis-h"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================
          CONTENU
          ============================================================ */}
      <p className="post-content">{post.content}</p>

      {post.image && (
        <div className="post-image">
          <img src={post.image} alt={`Post de ${post.author.name}`} loading="lazy" />
        </div>
      )}

      {post.tags && post.tags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="post-tags">
          {post.tags.map((tag: string) => (
            <span key={tag} className="post-tag">#{tag}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============================================================
          STATISTIQUES - TAHAKA NY SARY
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-stats">
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-heart" style={{ color: liked ? '#FF6B9D' : '#7A7A9A' }}></i>
          {formatNumber(likeCount)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          {formatNumber(post.comments)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-eye"></i>
          {formatNumber(post.shares)}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================
          ACTIONS
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-actions">
        <button
          className={`post-action-btn ${liked ? 'liked' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleLike}
          aria-label={liked ? 'Unlike' : 'Like'}
          aria-pressed={liked}
        >
          <i className={`fas fa-heart ${isAnimating ? 'animate-heart' : ''}`}></i>
          <span>Like</span>
        </button>

        <button
          className="post-action-btn"
          onClick={() => onComment(post.id)}
          aria-label="Commenter"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          <span>Comment</span>
        </button>

        <button
          className="post-action-btn"
          onClick={() => onShare(post.id)}
          aria-label="Partager"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
          <span>Share</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useLocalStorage } from '../hooks/useLocalStorage';
import '../styles/PostCard.css';

export interface PostData {
  id: string;
  author: {
    name: string;
    username: string;
    avatar: string;
    group: string;
  };
  content: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  likes: number;
  comments: number;
  shares: number;
  liked: boolean;
  tags: string[];
}

interface PostCardProps {
  post: PostData;
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
}

const PostCard: React.FC<PostCardProps> = ({ post, onLike, onComment, onShare }) => {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_liked`, post.liked);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_likes`, post.likes);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
  const [commentsList, setCommentsList] = useState<{id: string, author: string, text: string, time: string}[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (liked !== post.liked) {
      const newCount = liked ? likeCount + 1 : likeCount - 1;
      setLikeCount(Math.max(0, newCount));
    }
  }, [liked]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const savedComments = localStorage.getItem(`post_${post.id}_comments`);
    if (savedComments) {
      setCommentsList(JSON.parse(savedComments));
    }
  }, [post.id]);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string): string => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const handleLike = (): void => {
    const newLiked = !liked;
    setLiked(newLiked);
    setIsAnimating(true);
    onLike(post.id);
    setTimeout(() => setIsAnimating(false), 400);
  };

  const handleSave = (): void => {
    setSaved(!saved);
  };

  const handleShareClick = (): void => {
    onShare(post.id);
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/post/${post.id}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).then(() => {
      alert('Lien copiÃ© dans le presse-papier !');
    }).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copiez ce lien :', url);
    });
  };

  const handleAddComment = (): void => {
    if (!commentText.trim()) return;

      id: Date.now().toString(),
      author: 'K-Pop Fan',
      text: commentText.trim(),
      time: 'Just now'
    };
    
    const updatedComments = [newComment, ...commentsList];
    setCommentsList(updatedComments);
    localStorage.setItem(`post_${post.id}_comments`, JSON.stringify(updatedComments));
    setCommentText('');
    onComment(post.id);
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent): void => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleAddComment();
    }
  };

  const getInitial = (name: string): string => name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const getAvatarColor = (name: string): string => {
    const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22'];
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
      hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
    }
    return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
  };

  const formatNumber = (num: number): string => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return num.toString();
  };

  return (

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import '../styles/QuickComposer.css';

interface QuickComposerProps {
  onPostCreated: (content: string, image?: string) => void;
}

const QuickComposer: React.FC<QuickComposerProps> = ({ onPostCreated }) => {
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        setImage(event.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = () => {
    setImage(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!content.trim() && !image) return;
    onPostCreated(content, image || undefined);
    setContent('');
    setImage(null);
    setIsExpanded(false);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="quick-composer-wrapper">
      <div className="quick-composer">
        <div className="quick-composer-content" onClick={() => setIsExpanded(true)}>
          <div className="quick-composer-avatar">K</div>
          <span className="quick-composer-placeholder">
            {content || "What's happening in K-Pop?"}
          </span>
        </div>

        {isExpanded && (
          <div className="quick-composer-expanded">
            <textarea
              className="quick-composer-textarea"
              placeholder="What's happening in K-Pop?"
              value={content}
              onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
              onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
              rows={3}
              autoFocus
            />

            {image && (
              <div className="quick-composer-image-preview">
                <img src={image} alt="Preview" />
                <button className="quick-composer-remove-image" onClick={handleRemoveImage}>
                  <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="quick-composer-actions">
              <button className="composer-btn" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>
                <i className="fas fa-image"></i> Photo
              </button>
              <input
                type="file"
                ref={fileInputRef}
                accept="image/*"
                style={{ display: 'none' }}
                onChange={handleImageSelect}
              />
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-video"></i> Video</button>
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-file-image"></i> GIF</button>
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-smile"></i> Emoji</button>
              <button 
                className="composer-post" 
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!content.trim() && !image}
              >
                Post
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QuickComposer;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import '../styles/StoryViewer.css';

interface Story {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  avatar: string;
  group: string;
  content?: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  audience: 'public' | 'friends' | 'private';
  views: number;
  reactions: { emoji: string; count: number }[];
}

interface StoryViewerProps {
  stories: Story[];
  initialIndex: number;
  onClose: () => void;
  onShare: (storyId: string) => void;
  onReact: (storyId: string, emoji: string) => void;
}

const StoryViewer: React.FC<StoryViewerProps> = ({
  stories,
  initialIndex,
  onClose,
  onShare,
  onReact,
}) => {
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(initialIndex);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [showReactions, setShowReactions] = useState(false);
  const [showSendMessage, setShowSendMessage] = useState(false);
  const [messageText, setMessageText] = useState('');
  const progressInterval = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const touchStartX = useRef(0);
  const touchStartY = useRef(0);

  const currentStory = stories[currentIndex];
  const totalStories = stories.length;

  // ============================================================
  // PROGRESSION AUTOMATIQUE
  // ============================================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (progressInterval.current) {
      clearInterval(progressInterval.current);
    }

    if (!isPaused) {
      setProgress(0);
      progressInterval.current = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress(prev => {
          if (prev >= 100) {
            clearInterval(progressInterval.current!);
            goToNext();
            return 0;
          }
          return prev + 1;
        });
      }, 40);
    }

    return () => {
      if (progressInterval.current) {
        clearInterval(progressInterval.current);
      }
    };
  }, [currentIndex, isPaused]);

  // ============================================================
  // NAVIGATION
  // ============================================================
  const goToNext = () => {
    if (currentIndex < totalStories - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const goToPrevious = () => {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex - 1);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // TOUCH & CLICK EVENTS
  // ============================================================
  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    touchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    const diffX = touchStartX.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    const diffY = touchStartY.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
    
    if (Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY) && Math.abs(diffX) > 30) {
      if (diffX > 0) {
        goToNext();
      } else {
        goToPrevious();
      }
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    if (x < rect.width / 2) {
      goToPrevious();
    } else {
      goToNext();
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // REACTIONS
  // ============================================================
  const handleReact = (emoji: string) => {
    onReact(currentStory.id, emoji);
    setShowReactions(false);
  };

  // ============================================================
  // MESSAGE
  // ============================================================
  const handleSendMessage = () => {
    if (messageText.trim()) {
      alert(`Message envoyÃ© Ã  ${currentStory.author}: ${messageText}`);
      setMessageText('');
      setShowSendMessage(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      handleSendMessage();
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // SHARE
  // ============================================================
  const handleShare = () => {
    onShare(currentStory.id);
  };

  // ============================================================
  // FORMAT DATE
  // ============================================================
  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  // ============================================================
  // AUDIENCE ICON
  // ============================================================
  const getAudienceIcon = (audience: string) => {
    switch(audience) {
      case 'public': return 'fas fa-globe';
      case 'friends': return 'fas fa-user-friends';
      case 'private': return 'fas fa-lock';
      default: return 'fas fa-globe';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="story-viewer-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div 
        className="story-viewer-content"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
      >
        {/* BARRES DE PROGRESSION */}
        <div className="story-progress-bars">
          {stories.map((_, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="story-progress-track">
              <div 
                className="story-progress-bar"
                style={{
                  width: index === currentIndex ? `${progress}%` : 
                          index < currentIndex ? '100%' : '0%'
                }}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* EN-TÃŠTE */}
        <div className="story-header">
          <div className="story-author-info">
            <div className="story-author-avatar">{currentStory.avatar}</div>
            <div className="story-author-details">
              <div className="story-author-name">
                {currentStory.author}
                <span className="story-author-group">{currentStory.group}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="story-meta">
                <span className="story-timestamp">{formatTimeAgo(currentStory.timestamp)}</span>
                <span className="story-audience">
                  <i className={getAudienceIcon(currentStory.audience)}></i>
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="story-actions">
            <button className="story-action-btn" onClick={handleShare} title="Partager">
              <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
            </button>
            <button className="story-action-btn" onClick={onClose} title="Fermer">
              <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CONTENU DE LA STORY */}
        <div 
          className="story-body"
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        >
          {currentStory.image && (
            <img src={currentStory.image} alt="Story" className="story-image" />
          )}
          
          {currentStory.content && (
            <div className="story-text-overlay">
              <p className="story-text">{currentStory.content}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* FOOTER */}
        <div className="story-footer">
          <div className="story-views">
            <i className="fas fa-eye"></i> 
            <span>{currentStory.views.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          
          <div className="story-reactions">
            {currentStory.reactions.map((reaction, index) => (
              <span key={index} className="story-reaction-emoji" title={`${reaction.count} rÃ©actions`}>
                {reaction.emoji} 
                {reaction.count > 0 && <span className="reaction-count">{reaction.count}</span>}
              </span>
            ))}
            <button 
              className="story-add-reaction"
              onClick={() => setShowReactions(!showReactions)}
              title="Ajouter une rÃ©action"
            >
              <i className="fas fa-plus"></i>
            </button>
          </div>

          <button

          </button>
        </div>

        {/* MENU DES RÃ‰ACTIONS */}
        {showReactions && (
          <div className="story-reaction-menu">
            {['â¤ï¸', 'ğŸ˜‚', 'ğŸ˜®', 'ğŸ˜¢', 'ğŸ”¥', 'ğŸ’œ', 'ğŸ‘', 'ğŸ‰', 'ğŸ¥º', 'ğŸ˜'].map(emoji => (
              <button
                key={emoji}

export interface Post {
  id: string;
  author: {
    name: string;
    username: string;
    avatar: string;
    group: string;
  };
  content: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  likes: number;
  comments: number;
  shares: number;
  liked: boolean;
  tags: string[];
}

const getColorFromName = (name: string) => {
  const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#FF6B6B', '#2ECC71'];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
    hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
};

export const initializeLikes = (posts: Post[]): Post[] => {
  return posts.map(post => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(`post_${post.id}_liked`);
    if (saved !== null) {
      return { ...post, liked: JSON.parse(saved) };
    }
    return post;
  });
};

File: hooks\useLocalStorage.ts
================================================================================

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState<T>(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (item) {
        return JSON.parse(item);
      }
      return initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Erreur lors de la lecture de localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => {
    try {
      const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value;
      setStoredValue(valueToStore);
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Erreur lors de l'Ã©criture dans localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorageChange = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === key && event.newValue) {
        try {
          const newValue = JSON.parse(event.newValue);
          setStoredValue(newValue);
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn(`Erreur lors de la synchronisation de localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
  }, [key]);

  return [storedValue, setValue];
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import LeftSidebar from './LeftSidebar';
import RightSidebar from './RightSidebar';
import '../styles/MainLayout.css';

interface MainLayoutProps {
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  isDark: boolean;
}

const MainLayout: React.FC<MainLayoutProps> = ({ toggleTheme, isDark }) => {
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();

  const toggleMobileMenu = () => {
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(!isMobileMenuOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = !isMobileMenuOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  };

  // RightSidebar only on Home page
  const showRightSidebar = location.pathname === '/';

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
  }, [location]);

  return (
    <div className="main-layout">
      <Header
        toggleTheme={toggleTheme}
        isDark={isDark}
        onToggleMobileMenu={toggleMobileMenu}
        isMobileMenuOpen={isMobileMenuOpen}
      />
      <div className="main-layout-body">
        <LeftSidebar isOpen={isMobileMenuOpen} onClose={toggleMobileMenu} />
        <main className="main-layout-content">
          <div className="main-layout-content-inner">
            <Outlet />
          </div>
        </main>
        {showRightSidebar && <RightSidebar />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MainLayout;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/Auth.css';

const Auth: React.FC = () => {
  const [isLogin, setIsLogin] = useState(true);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [rememberMe, setRememberMe] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // Firebase authentication sera ajoutÃ© plus tard
    console.log('Form submitted:', { isLogin, email, password, username });
  };

  return (
    <div className="auth-page">
      <div className="auth-container">
        {/* ============================================================
            LOGO
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="auth-logo">
          <i className="fas fa-microphone auth-logo-icon"></i>
          <span className="auth-logo-text">K-POP UNITED</span>
        </div>

        <p className="auth-subtitle">
          {isLogin ? 'Welcome back to the K-Pop community!' : 'Join the ultimate K-Pop community!'}
        </p>

        {/* ============================================================
            FORMULAIRE
            ============================================================ */}
        <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          {/* Username - Register only */}
          {!isLogin && (
            <div className="auth-input-group">
              <i className="fas fa-user"></i>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Username"
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Email */}
          <div className="auth-input-group">
            <i className="fas fa-envelope"></i>
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="Email address"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
            />
          </div>

          {/* Password */}
          <div className="auth-input-group">
            <i className="fas fa-lock"></i>
            <input
              type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              placeholder="Password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              minLength={6}
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="auth-password-toggle"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
              aria-label="Toggle password visibility"
            >
              <i className={`fas ${showPassword ? 'fa-eye-slash' : 'fa-eye'}`}></i>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Confirm Password - Register only */}
          {!isLogin && (
            <div className="auth-input-group">
              <i className="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
              <input
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="Confirm password"
                required
                minLength={6}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Options - Login only */}
          {isLogin && (
            <div className="auth-options">
              <label className="auth-remember">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={rememberMe}
                  onChange={(e) => setRememberMe(e.target.checked)}
                />
                <span>Remember me</span>
              </label>
              <button type="button" className="auth-forgot">
                Forgot password?
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Submit Button */}
          <button type="submit" className="auth-submit">
            {isLogin ? 'Sign In' : 'Create Account'}
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* ============================================================
            DIVIDER
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="auth-divider">
          <span>or continue with</span>
        </div>

        {/* ============================================================
            SOCIAL BUTTONS
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="auth-social">
          <button className="auth-social-btn google" aria-label="Sign in with Google">
            <i className="fab fa-google"></i>
          </button>
          <button className="auth-social-btn kakao" aria-label="Sign in with Kakao">
            <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          </button>
          <button className="auth-social-btn naver" aria-label="Sign in with Naver">
            <i className="fas fa-n"></i>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ============================================================
            TOGGLE LOGIN / REGISTER
            ============================================================ */}
        <div className="auth-toggle">
          {isLogin ? (
            <p>
              Don't have an account?{' '}
              <button onClick={() => setIsLogin(false)}>Sign Up</button>
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p>
              Already have an account?{' '}
              <button onClick={() => setIsLogin(true)}>Sign In</button>

        {/* ============================================================

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/CreatePost.css';

const CreatePost: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState<'public' | 'followers' | 'private'>('public');

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (content.trim()) {
      console.log('Post created:', { content, image, privacy });
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  const handleImageUpload = () => {
    // Simuler l'upload d'image
    setImage('https://picsum.photos/seed/create/600/400');
  };

  return (
    <div className="create-post-page">
      <div className="create-post-header">
        <button className="create-post-cancel" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
          <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
        </button>
        <span className="create-post-title">Create Post</span>
        <button 
          className={`create-post-publish ${content.trim() ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={!content.trim()}
        >
          Publish
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="create-post-body">
        <div className="create-post-user">
          <div className="create-post-avatar">K</div>

            </div>

// ============================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================
interface Comment {

// ============================================================
// COMPOSANTS
// ============================================================

const Avatar: React.FC<{ name: string; size?: number; hasStory?: boolean }> = ({ name, size = 40, hasStory = false }) => {
  const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22'];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
    hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  const color = colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
  const initial = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div 
      className={`avatar ${hasStory ? 'avatar-story' : ''}`}
      style={{ 
        width: size, 
        height: size, 
        background: color,
        fontSize: size * 0.4,
        borderColor: hasStory ? 'transparent' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'
      }}
    >
      {initial}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================
// POST CARD
// ============================================================
interface PostCardProps {
  post: Post;
  onLike: (id: number) => void;
  onComment: (id: number, text: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: number) => void;
  onRepost: (id: number) => void;
  onSave: (id: number) => void;
  onReport: (id: number) => void;
  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
  onCopyLink: (id: number) => void;
}

const PostCard: React.FC<PostCardProps> = ({ 
  post, 
  onLike, 
  onComment, 
  onShare, 
  onRepost, 
  onSave, 
  onReport, 
  onDelete, 
  onCopyLink 
}) => {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useState(post.isLiked);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useState(post.likes);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(post.isSaved);
  const [reposted, setReposted] = useState(post.isReposted);
  const [repostCount, setRepostCount] = useState(post.reposts);
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
  const [commentsList, setCommentsList] = useState(post.commentsList);
  const [commentCount, setCommentCount] = useState(post.comments);
  const [showOptions, setShowOptions] = useState(false);
  const [showToast, setShowToast] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState('');
  
  const optionsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (optionsRef.current && !optionsRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setShowOptions(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const showToastMessage = (message: string) => {
    setToastMessage(message);
    setShowToast(true);
    setTimeout(() => setShowToast(false), 3000);
  };

  const handleLike = () => {
    const newLiked = !liked;
    setLiked(newLiked);
    setLikeCount(prev => newLiked ? prev + 1 : prev - 1);
    setIsAnimating(true);
    onLike(post.id);
    setTimeout(() => setIsAnimating(false), 400);
  };

  const handleAddComment = () => {
    if (!commentText.trim()) return;
    
    const newComment = {
      id: Date.now(),
      author: 'K-Pop Fan',
      text: commentText.trim(),
      time: 'Just now'
    };
    
    setCommentsList([newComment, ...commentsList]);
    setCommentCount(prev => prev + 1);
    onComment(post.id, commentText);
    setCommentText('');
    showToastMessage('Commentaire ajoutÃ© !');
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleAddComment();
    }
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    onShare(post.id);
    showToastMessage('Post partagÃ© !');
  };

  const handleRepost = () => {
    const newReposted = !reposted;
    setReposted(newReposted);
    setRepostCount(prev => newReposted ? prev + 1 : prev - 1);
    onRepost(post.id);
    showToastMessage(newReposted ? 'RepostÃ© !' : 'Repost retirÃ©');
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    const newSaved = !saved;
    setSaved(newSaved);
    onSave(post.id);
    showToastMessage(newSaved ? 'EnregistrÃ© !' : 'RetirÃ© des enregistrements');
  };

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    onCopyLink(post.id);
    setShowOptions(false);
    showToastMessage('Lien copiÃ© dans le presse-papier !');
  };

  const handleReport = () => {
    onReport(post.id);
    setShowOptions(false);
    showToastMessage('Post signalÃ©. Merci pour votre signalement.');
  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (window.confirm('Voulez-vous vraiment supprimer ce post ?')) {
      onDelete(post.id);
      setShowOptions(false);
      showToastMessage('Post supprimÃ©.');
    }
  };

  const formatNumber = (num: number) => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return num.toString();
  };

  return (
    <div className="post-card">
      <div className="post-header">
        <Avatar name={post.author} size={44} />
        <div className="post-author-info">
          <div className="post-author-name">
            {post.author}
            {post.verified && <span className="verification-badge">âœ“</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="post-meta">
            <span className="post-time">{formatTimeAgo(post.timestamp)}</span>
            <span className="post-audience">Â· <i className="fas fa-globe"></i></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="post-options-wrapper" ref={optionsRef}>
          <button 
            className="post-more-btn" 
            onClick={() => setShowOptions(!showOptions)}
            aria-label="Options"
          >
            <i className="fas fa-ellipsis-h"></i>
          </button>
          
          {showOptions && (
            <div className="post-options-menu">
              <button onClick={handleCopyLink} className="option-item">
                <i className="fas fa-link"></i> Copier le lien
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleReport} className="option-item">
                <i className="fas fa-flag"></i> Signaler
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleDelete} className="option-item delete">
                <i className="fas fa-trash"></i> Supprimer
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <p className="post-content">{post.content}</p>

      {post.image && (
        <div className="post-image">
          <img src={post.image} alt="" loading="lazy" />
        </div>
      )}

      {post.tags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="post-tags">
          {post.tags.map(tag => (
            <span key={tag} className="post-tag">#{tag}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="post-stats">
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-heart" style={{ color: liked ? '#FF6B9D' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' }}></i>
          {formatNumber(likeCount)}
        </span>
        <span 
          className="post-stat clickable" 
          onClick={() => setShowComments(!showComments)}
        >
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          {formatNumber(commentCount)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-retweet"></i>
          {formatNumber(repostCount)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
          {formatNumber(post.shares)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="post-actions">
        <button className={`post-action-btn ${liked ? 'liked' : ''}`} onClick={handleLike}>
          <i className={`fas fa-heart ${isAnimating ? 'animate-heart' : ''}`}></i>
          <span>Like</span>
        </button>
        
        <button className="post-action-btn" onClick={() => setShowComments(!showComments)}>
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          <span>Comment</span>
        </button>
        
        <button className={`post-action-btn ${reposted ? 'reposted' : ''}`} onClick={handleRepost}>
          <i className="fas fa-retweet"></i>
          <span>Repost</span>
        </button>
        
        <button className="post-action-btn" onClick={handleShare}>
          <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
          <span>Share</span>
        </button>
        
        <button className={`post-action-btn ${saved ? 'saved' : ''}`} onClick={handleSave}>
          <i className={`fas ${saved ? 'fa-bookmark' : 'fa-bookmark'}`}></i>
          <span>Save</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {showComments && (
        <div className="post-comments-section">
          <div className="comment-input-wrapper">
            <div className="comment-avatar-small">K</div>
            <input
              type="text"
              className="comment-input"
              placeholder="Write a comment..."
              value={commentText}
              onChange={(e) => setCommentText(e.target.value)}
              onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
            />
            <button 
              className="comment-send-btn" 
              onClick={handleAddComment}
              disabled={!commentText.trim()}
            >
              <i className="fas fa-paper-plane"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="comments-list">
            {commentsList.map(comment => (
              <div key={comment.id} className="comment-item">
                <div className="comment-avatar-small">{comment.author.charAt(0)}</div>
                <div className="comment-content">
                  <span className="comment-author">{comment.author}</span>
                  <span className="comment-text">{comment.text}</span>
                  <span className="comment-time">{comment.time}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
            {commentsList.length === 0 && (
              <div className="comments-empty">
                <i className="fas fa-comment-slash"></i>
                <span>No comments yet</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showToast && (
        <div className="toast-notification">
          <i className="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
          <span>{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

    : posts;

    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p =>

    ));
  };

  const handleShare = (id: number) => {
    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => 
      p.id === id ? { ...p, shares: p.shares + 1 } : p
    ));
  };

  const handleRepost = (id: number) => {
    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => 
      p.id === id ? { ...p, reposts: p.reposts + 1, isReposted: !p.isReposted } : p
    ));
  };

  const handleSave = (id: number) => {
    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => 
      p.id === id ? { ...p, isSaved: !p.isSaved } : p
    ));
  };

  const handleReport = (id: number) => {
    console.log('Post signalÃ©:', id);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: number) => {
    setPosts(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (id: number) => {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/post/${id}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url).catch(() => {
      prompt('Copiez ce lien :', url);
    });
  };

  const handleStoryClick = (index: number) => {
    setSelectedStoryIndex(index);
    setShowStoryViewer(true);
  };

  const handleStoryReact = (storyId: string, emoji: string) => {
    setStories(prev => prev.map(story => {
      if (story.id === storyId) {
        const existingReaction = story.reactions.find(r => r.emoji === emoji);
        if (existingReaction) {
          return {
            ...story,
            reactions: story.reactions.map(r => 
              r.emoji === emoji ? { ...r, count: r.count + 1 } : r
            )
          };
        } else {
          return {
            ...story,
            reactions: [...story.reactions, { emoji, count: 1 }]
          };
        }
      }
      return story;
    }));
  };

  const handleStoryShare = (storyId: string) => {
    alert('Story partagÃ©e !');
  };

  const handleCreateStory = (newStoryData: Omit<Story, 'id' | 'timestamp' | 'views' | 'reactions'>) => {
    const newStory: Story = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      ...newStoryData,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      views: 0,
      reactions: []
    };
    setStories([newStory, ...stories]);
  };

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        setPostImage(event.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = () => {
    setPostImage(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleCreatePost = () => {
    if (!postContent.trim() && !postImage) return;

    const newPost: Post = {

      reposts: 0,
      isLiked: false,
      isSaved: false,
      isReposted: false,
      tags: ['KPop', 'United'],
      commentsList: []
    };

    setPosts([newPost, ...posts]);
    setPostContent('');
    setPostImage(null);
    setIsComposerExpanded(false);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleCreatePost();
    }
  };

  return (

            </div>
            {stories.map((story, index) => (

              onChange={(e) => setPostContent(e.target.value)}
              onFocus={() => setIsComposerExpanded(true)}
              onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
            />
          </div>
          {isComposerExpanded && (
            <div className="composer-expanded">
              {postImage && (
                <div className="composer-image-preview">
                  <img src={postImage} alt="Preview" />
                  <button className="composer-remove-image" onClick={handleRemoveImage}>
                    <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="composer-actions">
                <button className="composer-btn" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>
                  <i className="fas fa-image"></i> Photo
                </button>
                <input type="file" ref={fileInputRef} accept="image/*" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={handleImageSelect} />
                <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-video"></i> Video</button>
                <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-file-image"></i> GIF</button>
                <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-smile"></i> Emoji</button>
                <button className="composer-post" onClick={handleCreatePost} disabled={!postContent.trim() && !postImage}>Post</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* FEED */}
        <div className="feed">
          {filteredPosts.map(post => (
            <PostCard
              key={post.id}
              post={post}
              onLike={handleLike}
              onComment={handleComment}
              onShare={handleShare}
              onRepost={handleRepost}
              onSave={handleSave}
              onReport={handleReport}
              onDelete={handleDelete}
              onCopyLink={handleCopyLink}
            />
          ))}
          {filteredPosts.length === 0 && (
            <div className="feed-empty">
              <i className="fas fa-search"></i>
              <h3>No results found</h3>
              <p>Try adjusting your search terms</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* STORY CREATOR */}
      <StoryCreator isOpen={showStoryCreator} onClose={() => setShowStoryCreator(false)} onCreateStory={handleCreateStory} />
      
      {/* STORY VIEWER */}
      {showStoryViewer && (
        <StoryViewer
          stories={stories}
          initialIndex={selectedStoryIndex}
          onClose={() => setShowStoryViewer(false)}
          onShare={handleStoryShare}
          onReact={handleStoryReact}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Home;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/Notifications.css';

const Notifications: React.FC = () => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'unread' | 'mentions'>('all');

  const notifications = [
    { id: 1, type: 'like', user: 'ARMY_Leader', content: 'liked your post', target: 'BTS 10th Anniversary', time: '2 min ago', read: false },
    { id: 2, type: 'comment', user: 'BLINK_Captain', content: 'commented on your post', target: 'BLACKPINK World Tour', time: '15 min ago', read: false },
    { id: 3, type: 'follow', user: 'TWICE_Artist', content: 'started following you', time: '1 hour ago', read: false },
    { id: 4, type: 'mention', user: 'MOA_Helper', content: 'mentioned you in a comment', target: 'TXT New Album', time: '3 hours ago', read: true },
    { id: 5, type: 'follow', user: 'NCTzen_Official', content: 'started following you', time: '5 hours ago', read: true },
  ];

  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch(type) {
      case 'like': return 'fa-heart';
      case 'comment': return 'fa-comment';
      case 'follow': return 'fa-user-plus';
      case 'mention': return 'fa-at';
      default: return 'fa-bell';
    }
  };

  const getColor = (type: string) => {
    switch(type) {
      case 'like': return '#FF6B9D';
      case 'comment': return '#4A90D9';
      case 'follow': return '#00B894';
      case 'mention': return '#FDCB6E';
      default: return '#7A7A9A';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="notifications-page">
      <div className="notifications-header">
        <h2 className="notifications-title">
          <i className="fas fa-bell"></i> Notifications
        </h2>
        <div className="notifications-filters">
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('all')}>All</button>
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'unread' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('unread')}>Unread</button>
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'mentions' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('mentions')}>Mentions</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notifications-list">
        {notifications.map((notif) => (
          <div key={notif.id} className={`notification-item ${notif.read ? 'read' : 'unread'}`}>
            <div className="notification-icon" style={{ background: getColor(notif.type) }}>
              <i className={`fas ${getIcon(notif.type)}`}></i>
            </div>
            <div className="notification-content">
              <div className="notification-user">
                <span className="notification-username">{notif.user}</span>
                <span className="notification-action">{notif.content}</span>
              </div>
              {notif.target && (
                <span className="notification-target">{notif.target}</span>
              )}
              <span className="notification-time">{notif.time}</span>
            </div>
            {!notif.read && <div className="notification-dot"></div>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Notifications;

      isNew: false,
    },
    {
      id: 12,
      title: 'ZEROBASEONE - Debut Stage Compilation',
      thumbnail: 'https://via.placeholder.com/320x180/FFD700/FFFFFF?text=ZB1+Debut',
      channel: 'K-POP Compilations',
      channelAvatar: 'https://via.placeholder.com/40x40/FFD700/FFFFFF?text=KC',
      views: 1900000,
      timestamp: '1 month ago',
      duration: '15:00',
      category: 'Compilation',
      isNew: false,
    },
  ]);

  const categories = ['all', 'Music Video', 'Live Performance', 'Behind', 'Vlog', 'Dance Practice', 'Reaction', 'Cover', 'Compilation', 'Music'];

  const filteredVideos = videos.filter(video => {
    const matchesSearch = video.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                           video.channel.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || video.category === activeCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const formatViews = (views: number) => {
    if (views >= 10000000) return (views / 10000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (views >= 1000000) return (views / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (views >= 1000) return (views / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return views.toString();
  };

  return (
    <div className="videos-page">
      <div className="videos-header">
        <h2 className="videos-title">
          <i className="fas fa-video" style={{ color: '#FF4500' }}></i> Videos
