            placeholder="Search videos, channels..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="videos-categories">
        {categories.map((category) => (
          <button
            key={category}
            className={`category-btn ${activeCategory === category ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
          >
            {category === 'all' ? 'All' : category}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="videos-grid">
        {filteredVideos.length > 0 ? (
          filteredVideos.map((video) => (
            <div key={video.id} className="video-card">
              <Link to={`/videos/${video.id}`} className="video-thumbnail">
                <img src={video.thumbnail} alt={video.title} />
                <span className="video-duration">{video.duration}</span>
                {video.isNew && <span className="video-new-badge">NEW</span>}
              </Link>
              <div className="video-info">
                <Link to={`/videos/${video.id}`} className="video-title">
                  {video.title}
                </Link>
                <div className="video-channel">
                  <img src={video.channelAvatar} alt={video.channel} className="channel-avatar" />
                  <span className="channel-name">{video.channel}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="video-meta">
                  <span className="video-views">{formatViews(video.views)} views</span>
                  <span className="video-timestamp">â€¢ {video.timestamp}</span>
                </div>
                <span className="video-category-tag">{video.category}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="videos-empty">
            <i className="fas fa-video"></i>
            <h3>No videos found</h3>
            <p>Try adjusting your search or filters</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Videos;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/BottomNavigation.css';

interface BottomNavigationProps {
  currentTab: string;
  onTabChange: (tab: string) => void;
}

const BottomNavigation: React.FC<BottomNavigationProps> = ({ currentTab, onTabChange }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'home', icon: 'fa-house', label: 'Home', path: '/' },
    { id: 'explore', icon: 'fa-compass', label: 'Explore', path: '/explore' },
    { id: 'create', icon: 'fa-plus', label: '', path: '/create', isCreate: true },
    { id: 'notifications', icon: 'fa-bell', label: 'Notifications', path: '/notifications' },
    { id: 'profile', icon: 'fa-user', label: 'Profile', path: '/profile' },
  ];

  const handleTabClick = (tab: typeof tabs[0]) => {
    if (tab.isCreate) {
      navigate('/create');
    } else {
      onTabChange(tab.id);
      navigate(tab.path);
    }
  };

  return (
    <nav className="bottom-nav">
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = location.pathname === tab.path || 
          (tab.id === 'home' && location.pathname === '/');
        
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            className={`bottom-nav-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''} ${tab.isCreate ? 'create-btn' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleTabClick(tab)}
            aria-label={tab.label || 'Create post'}
          >
            {tab.isCreate ? (
              <div className="create-icon-wrapper">
                <i className={`fas ${tab.icon}`}></i>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <i className={`fas ${tab.icon}`}></i>
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
};

export default BottomNavigation;

import React, { useState, useRef } from "react";
import "../styles/CreatePost.css";

interface CreatePostProps {
  onPostCreated: (content: string, image?: string) => void;
}

const CreatePost: React.FC<CreatePostProps> = ({ onPostCreated }) => {
  const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [showEmojiPicker, setShowEmojiPicker] = useState(false);
  const [characterCount, setCharacterCount] = useState(0);
  const [showToast, setShowToast] = useState(false);
  const [allowComments, setAllowComments] = useState(true);
  const [allowLikes, setAllowLikes] = useState(true);
  const [showSchedule, setShowSchedule] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const maxChars = 500;

  const emojis = [
    "??", "??", "??", "??", "??", "??", "?", "??", "??", "??",
    "??", "??", "??", "??", "??", "??"
  ];

  const handleContentChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    if (value.length <= maxChars) {
      setContent(value);
      setCharacterCount(value.length);
    }
  };

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        setImage(event.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = () => {
    setImage(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (content.trim() || image) {
      onPostCreated(content, image || undefined);
      setContent("");
      setImage(null);
      setCharacterCount(0);
      setIsExpanded(false);
      setShowEmojiPicker(false);
      setShowToast(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShowToast(false), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (content.trim() || image) handleSubmit();
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setIsExpanded(false);
      setShowEmojiPicker(false);
    }
  };

  const addEmoji = (emoji: string) => {
    setContent((prev) => prev + emoji);
    setCharacterCount((prev) => prev + emoji.length);
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const isPostable = content.trim().length > 0 || image !== null;

  return (
    <div className="create-post-container">
      {/* COMPACT HEADER */}
      <div className="create-post-compact" onClick={() => setIsExpanded(true)}>
        <div className="create-post-avatar">
          <span>K</span>
        </div>
        <div className="create-post-placeholder">
          {content || "What's happening in K-Pop?"}
        </div>
        <button className="create-post-compact-btn" aria-label="Add photo">
          <i className="fas fa-image"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* EXPANDED COMPOSER */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="create-post-expanded">
          {/* USER INFO */}
          <div className="create-post-user">
            <div className="create-post-user-avatar">K</div>
            <div className="create-post-user-info">
              <div className="create-post-username">
                K-Pop Fan
                <span className="create-post-verified">
                  <i className="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="create-post-audience">
                <i className="fas fa-globe"></i>
                <span>Public</span>
                <i className="fas fa-chevron-down"></i>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* TEXTAREA */}
          <div className="create-post-textarea-wrapper">
            <textarea
              ref={textareaRef}
              className="create-post-textarea"
              placeholder="What's happening in K-Pop? Share your thoughts..."
              value={content}
              onChange={handleContentChange}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              rows={4}
              autoFocus
            />
            <div className="create-post-char-counter">
              <span className={characterCount > maxChars * 0.9 ? "warning" : ""}>
                {characterCount}/{maxChars}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* IMAGE PREVIEW */}
          {image && (
            <div className="create-post-image-preview">
              <img src={image} alt="Preview" />
              <button className="create-post-remove-image" onClick={handleRemoveImage}>
                <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TOOLBAR */}
          <div className="create-post-toolbar">
            <button className="create-post-tool" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>
              <i className="fas fa-image"></i>
              <span>Photo</span>
            </button>
            <input
              type="file"
              ref={fileInputRef}
              accept="image/*"
              style={{ display: "none" }}
              onChange={handleImageSelect}
            />
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-video"></i>
              <span>Video</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-music"></i>
              <span>Music</span>
            </button>
            <button
              className="create-post-tool"
              onClick={() => setShowEmojiPicker(!showEmojiPicker)}
            >
              <i className="fas fa-smile"></i>
              <span>Emoji</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-file-image"></i>
              <span>GIF</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-chart-bar"></i>
              <span>Poll</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-hashtag"></i>
              <span>#</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-at"></i>
              <span>@</span>
            </button>
            <button className="create-post-tool">
              <i className="fas fa-map-pin"></i>
              <span>Location</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* EMOJI PICKER */}
          {showEmojiPicker && (
            <div className="create-post-emoji-picker">
              {emojis.map((emoji) => (
                <button
                  key={emoji}
                  className="create-post-emoji"
                  onClick={() => addEmoji(emoji)}
                >
                  {emoji}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* OPTIONS */}
          <div className="create-post-options">
            <div className="create-post-options-left">
              <button
                className="create-post-option"
                onClick={() => setShowSchedule(!showSchedule)}
              >
                <i className="fas fa-clock"></i>
                <span>Schedule</span>
              </button>
              <label className="create-post-option toggle">
                <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
                <span>Comments</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={allowComments}
                  onChange={() => setAllowComments(!allowComments)}
                />
                <span className="create-post-toggle-slider"></span>
              </label>
              <label className="create-post-option toggle">
                <i className="fas fa-heart"></i>
                <span>Likes</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={allowLikes}
                  onChange={() => setAllowLikes(!allowLikes)}
                />
                <span className="create-post-toggle-slider"></span>
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="create-post-options-right">
              <button
                className="create-post-discard"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsExpanded(false);
                  setShowEmojiPicker(false);
                  setContent("");
                  setImage(null);
                  setCharacterCount(0);
                }}
              >
                Discard
              </button>
              <button
                className={`create-post-submit ${isPostable ? "active" : ""}`}
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!isPostable}
              >
                <span>Post</span>
                <i className="fas fa-arrow-right"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* SCHEDULE */}
          {showSchedule && (
            <div className="create-post-schedule">
              <i className="fas fa-calendar-alt"></i>
              <input type="datetime-local" className="create-post-schedule-input" />
              <button className="create-post-schedule-btn">Set</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

interface FeedProps {
  posts: PostData[];
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  emptyMessage?: string;
}

const Feed: React.FC<FeedProps> = ({
  posts,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onShare,
  loading = false,
  emptyMessage = 'No posts to display',
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-loading">
        <div className="feed-loading-spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading posts...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-empty">
        <i className="fas fa-inbox"></i>
        <h3>{emptyMessage}</h3>
        <p>Check back later for updates from the K-Pop community!</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="feed">
      {posts.map(post => (
        <Post
          key={post.id}
          post={post}
          onLike={onLike}
          onComment={onComment}
          onShare={onShare}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import Header from './Header';
import Sidebar from './Sidebar';
import RightSidebar from './RightSidebar';

interface LayoutProps {
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  isDark: boolean;
}

const Layout: React.FC<LayoutProps> = ({ toggleTheme, isDark }) => {
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();

  const toggleMobileMenu = () => {
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(!isMobileMenuOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = !isMobileMenuOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  };

  const showRightSidebar = location.pathname === '/';
  const bodyClass = showRightSidebar ? 'app-body' : 'app-body no-right-sidebar';

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
  }, [location]);

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <Header 
        toggleTheme={toggleTheme} 
        isDark={isDark}
        onToggleMobileMenu={toggleMobileMenu}
        isMobileMenuOpen={isMobileMenuOpen}
      />
      <div className={bodyClass}>
        <Sidebar isOpen={isMobileMenuOpen} onClose={toggleMobileMenu} />
        <main className="app-main">
          <div className="app-content-wrapper">
            <Outlet />
          </div>
        </main>
        {showRightSidebar && <RightSidebar />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocalStorage } from '../hooks/useLocalStorage';
import '../styles/Post.css';

// ============================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================
export interface PostData {
  id: string;
  author: {
    name: string;
    username: string;
    avatar: string;
    group: string;
  };
  content: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  likes: number;
  comments: number;
  shares: number;
  liked: boolean;
  tags: string[];
}

interface PostProps {
  post: PostData;
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
}

// ============================================================
// COMPOSANT PRINCIPAL
// ============================================================
const Post: React.FC<PostProps> = ({ post, onLike, onComment, onShare }) => {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_liked`, post.liked);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useLocalStorage(`post_${post.id}_likes`, post.likes);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (liked !== post.liked) {
      const newCount = liked ? likeCount + 1 : likeCount - 1;
      setLikeCount(Math.max(0, newCount));
    }
  }, [liked]);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string): string => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const handleLike = (): void => {
    const newLiked = !liked;
    setLiked(newLiked);
    setIsAnimating(true);
    onLike(post.id);
    setTimeout(() => setIsAnimating(false), 400);
  };

  const getInitial = (name: string): string => name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  const getAvatarColor = (name: string): string => {
    const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22'];
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
      hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
    }
    return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
  };

  // Formatage des nombres (ex: 24800 â†’ 24.8K)
  const formatNumber = (num: number): string => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return num.toString();
  };

  return (
    <article className="post-card">
      {/* ============================================================
          EN-TÃŠTE - AVATAR + NOM + MÃ‰TA
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-header">
        <div
          className="post-avatar"
          style={{ background: getAvatarColor(post.author.name) }}
        >
          {getInitial(post.author.name)}
        </div>
        <div className="post-author-info">
          <span className="post-author-name">{post.author.name}</span>
          <div className="post-author-meta">
            <span className="post-group">{post.author.group}</span>
            <span className="post-time">Â· {formatTimeAgo(post.timestamp)}</span>
            <span className="post-audience">Â· <i className="fas fa-globe"></i> Public</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button className="post-options-btn" aria-label="Options">
          <i className="fas fa-ellipsis-h"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================
          CONTENU
          ============================================================ */}
      <p className="post-content">{post.content}</p>

      {post.image && (
        <div className="post-image">
          <img src={post.image} alt={`Post de ${post.author.name}`} loading="lazy" />
        </div>
      )}

      {post.tags && post.tags.length > 0 && (
        <div className="post-tags">
          {post.tags.map((tag: string) => (
            <span key={tag} className="post-tag">#{tag}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============================================================
          STATISTIQUES - TAHAKA NY SARY
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-stats">
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-heart" style={{ color: liked ? '#FF6B9D' : '#7A7A9A' }}></i>
          {formatNumber(likeCount)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          {formatNumber(post.comments)}
        </span>
        <span className="post-stat">
          <i className="fas fa-eye"></i>
          {formatNumber(post.shares)}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================
          ACTIONS
          ============================================================ */}
      <div className="post-actions">
        <button
          className={`post-action-btn ${liked ? 'liked' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleLike}
          aria-label={liked ? 'Unlike' : 'Like'}
          aria-pressed={liked}
        >
          <i className={`fas fa-heart ${isAnimating ? 'animate-heart' : ''}`}></i>
          <span>Like</span>
        </button>

        <button
          className="post-action-btn"
          onClick={() => onComment(post.id)}
          aria-label="Commenter"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
          <span>Comment</span>
        </button>

          onClick={() => onShare(post.id)}
          aria-label="Partager"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
          <span>Share</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>

import '../styles/PostCard.css';

interface Comment {
  id: number;
  author: string;

  time: string;
}

interface Post {
  id: number;
  author: string;
  username: string;
  avatar: string;
  group: string;
  verified: boolean;
  content: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  likes: number;
  comments: number;
  shares: number;
  reposts: number;
  isLiked: boolean;
  isSaved: boolean;
  isReposted: boolean;
  tags: string[];
  commentsList: Comment[];
}

interface PostCardProps {
  post: Post;
  onLike: (id: number) => void;
  onComment: (id: number, text: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: number) => void;
  onRepost: (id: number) => void;
  onSave: (id: number) => void;
  onReport: (id: number) => void;
  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
  onCopyLink: (id: number) => void;
}

const PostCard: React.FC<PostCardProps> = ({
  post,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onShare,
  onRepost,
  onSave,
  onReport,
  onDelete,
  onCopyLink,
}) => {
  const [liked, setLiked] = useState(post.isLiked);
  const [likeCount, setLikeCount] = useState(post.likes);
  const [isAnimating, setIsAnimating] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(post.isSaved);
  const [reposted, setReposted] = useState(post.isReposted);
  const [repostCount, setRepostCount] = useState(post.reposts);
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
  const [commentsList, setCommentsList] = useState(post.commentsList);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const handleLike = () => {
    const newLiked = !liked;
    setLiked(newLiked);
    setLikeCount(prev => newLiked ? prev + 1 : prev - 1);
    setIsAnimating(true);
    onLike(post.id);
    setTimeout(() => setIsAnimating(false), 400);

      id: Date.now(),

      text: commentText.trim(),

    };

    setCommentsList([newComment, ...commentsList]);
    setCommentCount(prev => prev + 1);
    onComment(post.id, commentText);
    setCommentText('');

    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleAddComment();
    }
  };

    onShare(post.id);
  };

  const handleRepost = () => {
    const newReposted = !reposted;
    setReposted(newReposted);
    setRepostCount(prev => newReposted ? prev + 1 : prev - 1);
    onRepost(post.id);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    const newSaved = !saved;
    setSaved(newSaved);
    onSave(post.id);
  };

  const formatNumber = (num: number) => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';

    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
      hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
    }
    return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];

          <div className="post-author-name">
            {post.author}
            {post.verified && <span className="verification-badge">âœ“</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="post-meta">
            <span className="post-time">{formatTimeAgo(post.timestamp)}</span>
            <span className="post-group">Â· {post.group}</span>
            <span className="post-audience">Â· <i className="fas fa-globe"></i></span>
          </div>

        </button>

          color: '#FFFFFF',

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import '../styles/QuickComposer.css';

interface QuickComposerProps {
  onPostCreated: (content: string, image?: string) => void;
}

const QuickComposer: React.FC<QuickComposerProps> = ({ onPostCreated }) => {
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleImageSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        setImage(event.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = () => {
    setImage(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!content.trim() && !image) return;
    onPostCreated(content, image || undefined);
    setContent('');
    setImage(null);
    setIsExpanded(false);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="quick-composer-wrapper">
      <div className="quick-composer">
        <div className="quick-composer-content" onClick={() => setIsExpanded(true)}>
          <div className="quick-composer-avatar">K</div>
          <span className="quick-composer-placeholder">
            {content || "What's happening in K-Pop?"}
          </span>
        </div>

        {isExpanded && (
          <div className="quick-composer-expanded">
            <textarea
              className="quick-composer-textarea"
              placeholder="What's happening in K-Pop?"
              value={content}
              onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
              onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
              rows={3}
              autoFocus
            />

            {image && (
              <div className="quick-composer-image-preview">
                <img src={image} alt="Preview" />
                <button className="quick-composer-remove-image" onClick={handleRemoveImage}>
                  <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="quick-composer-actions">
              <button className="composer-btn" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>
                <i className="fas fa-image"></i> Photo
              </button>
              <input
                type="file"
                ref={fileInputRef}
                accept="image/*"
                style={{ display: 'none' }}
                onChange={handleImageSelect}
              />
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-video"></i> Video</button>
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-file-image"></i> GIF</button>
              <button className="composer-btn"><i className="fas fa-smile"></i> Emoji</button>
              <button 
                className="composer-post" 
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!content.trim() && !image}
              >
                Post
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QuickComposer;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/SearchBar.css';

interface SearchBarProps {
  placeholder?: string;
  onSearch: (query: string) => void;
  initialValue?: string;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}

const SearchBar: React.FC<SearchBarProps> = ({
  placeholder = 'Search artists, groups, songs...',
  onSearch,
  initialValue = '',
  autoFocus = false,
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialValue);
  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = useState(false);

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setQuery(value);
    onSearch(value);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setQuery('');
    onSearch('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (query.trim()) {
      onSearch(query.trim());
    }
  };

  return (
    <form 
      className={`search-bar ${isFocused ? 'focused' : ''}`}
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      role="search"
      aria-label="Barre de recherche"
    >
      <i className="fas fa-search search-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      <input
        type="text"
        className="search-input"
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={query}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onFocus={() => setIsFocused(true)}
        onBlur={() => setIsFocused(false)}
        autoFocus={autoFocus}
        aria-label="Rechercher des artistes, groupes, chansons"
      />
      {query && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="search-clear"
          onClick={handleClear}
          aria-label="Effacer la recherche"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-times-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
      )}
      <button 
        type="submit" 
        className="search-submit"
        aria-label="Lancer la recherche"
      >
        <i className="fas fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};

export default SearchBar;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import '../styles/StoryViewer.css';

interface Story {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  avatar: string;
  group: string;
  content?: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  audience: 'public' | 'friends' | 'private';
  views: number;
  reactions: { emoji: string; count: number }[];
  isOwner?: boolean;
  isViewed?: boolean;
}

interface StoryViewerProps {
  stories: Story[];
  initialIndex: number;
  onClose: () => void;
  onShare: (storyId: string) => void;
  onReact: (storyId: string, emoji: string) => void;
}

const StoryViewer: React.FC<StoryViewerProps> = ({
  stories,
  initialIndex,
  onClose,
  onShare,
  onReact,
}) => {
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(initialIndex);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [showReactions, setShowReactions] = useState(false);
  const [showSendMessage, setShowSendMessage] = useState(false);
  const [messageText, setMessageText] = useState('');
  const progressInterval = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const touchStartX = useRef(0);
  const touchStartY = useRef(0);
  const bodyRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const currentStory = stories[currentIndex];
  const totalStories = stories.length;

  // ============================================================
  // PROGRESSION AUTOMATIQUE
  // ============================================================
  useEffect(() => {
    if (progressInterval.current) {
      clearInterval(progressInterval.current);
    }

    if (!isPaused && !showReactions && !showSendMessage) {
      setProgress(0);
      progressInterval.current = setInterval(() => {
        setProgress(prev => {
          if (prev >= 100) {
            clearInterval(progressInterval.current!);
            goToNext();
            return 0;
          }
          return prev + 1;
        });
      }, 40);
    }

    return () => {
      if (progressInterval.current) {
        clearInterval(progressInterval.current);
      }
    };
  }, [currentIndex, isPaused, showReactions, showSendMessage]);

  // ============================================================
  // NAVIGATION
  // ============================================================
  const goToNext = () => {
    if (currentIndex < totalStories - 1) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex + 1);
      setIsPaused(false);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const goToPrevious = () => {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      setCurrentIndex(currentIndex - 1);
      setIsPaused(false);
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // PAUSE / PLAY
  // ============================================================
  const togglePause = () => {
    setIsPaused(!isPaused);
  };

  // ============================================================
  // TOUCH & CLICK EVENTS
  // ============================================================
  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    touchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    const diffX = touchStartX.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    const diffY = touchStartY.current - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
    
    if (Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY) && Math.abs(diffX) > 30) {
      if (diffX > 0) {
        goToNext();
      } else {
        goToPrevious();
      }
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // CLICK GAUCHE/DROITE/MILIEU
  // ============================================================
  const handleBodyClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const width = rect.width;
    
    if (x < width * 0.3) {
      goToPrevious();
    } else if (x > width * 0.7) {
      goToNext();
    } else {
      togglePause();
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // REACTIONS
  // ============================================================
  const handleOpenReactions = () => {
    setShowReactions(true);
  };

  const handleCloseReactions = () => {
    setShowReactions(false);
  };

  const handleReact = (emoji: string) => {
    onReact(currentStory.id, emoji);
    handleCloseReactions();
  };

  // ============================================================
  // MESSAGE
  // ============================================================
  const handleOpenMessage = () => {
    setShowSendMessage(true);
  };

  const handleCloseMessage = () => {
    setShowSendMessage(false);
    setMessageText('');
  };

  const handleSendMessage = () => {
    if (messageText.trim()) {
      alert(`Message envoyÃ© Ã  ${currentStory.author}: ${messageText}`);
      handleCloseMessage();
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      handleSendMessage();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      handleCloseMessage();
      handleCloseReactions();
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // SHARE
  // ============================================================
  const handleShare = () => {
    onShare(currentStory.id);
  };

  // ============================================================
  // FORMAT DATE
  // ============================================================
  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  // ============================================================
  // AUDIENCE ICON
  // ============================================================
  const getAudienceIcon = (audience: string) => {
    switch(audience) {
      case 'public': return 'fas fa-globe';
      case 'friends': return 'fas fa-user-friends';
      case 'private': return 'fas fa-lock';
      default: return 'fas fa-globe';
    }
  };

  // ============================================================
  // RENDER FOOTER â€“ PRIVÃ‰ POUR LE PROPRIÃ‰TAIRE
  // ============================================================
  const renderFooter = () => {
    const isOwner = currentStory.isOwner === true;

    return (
      <div className="story-footer">
        <div className="story-views" style={{ visibility: isOwner ? 'visible' : 'hidden' }}>
          <i className="fas fa-eye"></i> 
          <span>{isOwner ? currentStory.views.toLocaleString() : '0'}</span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="story-reactions">
          {isOwner && currentStory.reactions.map((reaction, index) => (
            <span key={index} className="story-reaction-emoji" title={`${reaction.count} rÃ©actions`}>
              {reaction.emoji} 
              {reaction.count > 0 && <span className="reaction-count">{reaction.count}</span>}
            </span>
          ))}
          <button 
            className="story-add-reaction"
            onClick={handleOpenReactions}
            title="Ajouter une rÃ©action"
          >
            <i className="fas fa-plus"></i>
          </button>
        </div>

        <button 
          className="story-message-btn"
          onClick={handleOpenMessage}
          title="Envoyer un message"
        >
          <i className="fas fa-paper-plane"></i>
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // ============================================================
  // PAUSE INDICATOR
  // ============================================================
  const renderPauseIndicator = () => {

              <div

                  width: index === currentIndex ? `${progress}%` : 
                          index < currentIndex ? '100%' : '0%'
                }}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="story-header">
          <div className="story-author-info">
            <div className="story-author-avatar">{currentStory.avatar}</div>

              <div className="story-author-name">

const getColorFromName = (name: string) => {
  const colors = ['#FF6B9D', '#9B59B6', '#6C5CE7', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#FF6B6B', '#2ECC71'];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
    hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
};

===== C:\Users\ss\Documents\PRESENTATION\projet\src\hooks\useLocalStorage.ts =====

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState<T>(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (item) {
        return JSON.parse(item);
      }
      return initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Erreur lors de la lecture de localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = (value: T | ((val: T) => T)) => {
    try {
      const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value;
      setStoredValue(valueToStore);
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Erreur lors de l'Ã©criture dans localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorageChange = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === key && event.newValue) {
        try {
          const newValue = JSON.parse(event.newValue);
          setStoredValue(newValue);
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn(`Erreur lors de la synchronisation de localStorage pour la clÃ© "${key}":`, error);
        }
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
  }, [key]);

  return [storedValue, setValue];
}

  icon: string;
}

const LeftSidebar: React.FC<LeftSidebarProps> = ({ isOpen = false, onClose }) => {
  const navItems: NavItem[] = [
    { to: '/', label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/CreatePost.css';

const CreatePost: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [image, setImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState<'public' | 'followers' | 'private'>('public');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmDialog, setShowConfirmDialog] = useState(false);
  const [characterCount, setCharacterCount] = useState(0);
  const [showToast, setShowToast] = useState(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState('');
  const [showEmojiPicker, setShowEmojiPicker] = useState(false);
  const [allowComments, setAllowComments] = useState(true);
  const [allowLikes, setAllowLikes] = useState(true);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const maxChars = 500;

  const emojis = [
    'ğŸ˜Š', 'ğŸ˜‚', 'â¤ï¸', 'ğŸ”¥', 'ğŸ’œ', 'ğŸ‰', 'âœ¨', 'ğŸ‘', 'ğŸ¥º', 'ğŸ˜',
    'ğŸ’¯', 'ğŸµ', 'ğŸ¶', 'ğŸŒŸ', 'ğŸ’ª', 'ğŸ¤—', 'ğŸ˜', 'ğŸ¤©', 'ğŸ’–', 'ğŸŒˆ'
  ];

  const handleContentChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    if (value.length <= maxChars) {
      setContent(value);
      setCharacterCount(value.length);
    }
  };

  const handleImageUpload = () => {
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setIsUploading(true);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        setImage(event.target?.result as string);
        setIsUploading(false);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = () => {
    setImage(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  const showToastMessage = (message: string) => {
    setToastMessage(message);
    setShowToast(true);
    setTimeout(() => setShowToast(false), 3000);
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!content.trim() && !image) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      console.log('Post created:', { content, image, privacy });
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      showToastMessage('âœ¨ Post published successfully!');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate('/');
      }, 1000);
    }, 1500);
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    if (content.trim() || image) {
      setShowConfirmDialog(true);
    } else {
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmCancel = () => {
    setShowConfirmDialog(false);
    navigate('/');
  };

  const handleCancelCancel = () => {
    setShowConfirmDialog(false);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      handleCancel();
    }
  };

  const getPrivacyIcon = () => {
    switch(privacy) {
      case 'public': return 'fas fa-globe';
      case 'followers': return 'fas fa-user-friends';
      case 'private': return 'fas fa-lock';
      default: return 'fas fa-globe';
    }
  };

  const getPrivacyLabel = () => {
    switch(privacy) {
      case 'public': return 'Public';
      case 'followers': return 'Followers';
      case 'private': return 'Private';
      default: return 'Public';
    }
  };

  const isPostable = content.trim().length > 0 || image !== null;

  const addEmoji = (emoji: string) => {
    setContent(prev => prev + emoji);
    setCharacterCount(prev => prev + emoji.length);
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div className="create-post-page" onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}>
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="create-post-header">
        <button className="create-post-cancel" onClick={handleCancel}>
          <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
        </button>
        <span className="create-post-title">Create Post</span>
        <button 
          className={`create-post-publish ${isPostable && !isSubmitting ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={!isPostable || isSubmitting}
        >
          {isSubmitting ? (
            <>
              <span className="create-post-spinner-small"></span>
              <span>Posting...</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <span>Publish</span>
              <i className="fas fa-arrow-right"></i>
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* BODY */}
      <div className="create-post-body">
        {/* USER INFO */}
        <div className="create-post-user">
          <div className="create-post-avatar-wrapper">
            <div className="create-post-avatar">K</div>
            <div className="create-post-avatar-ring"></div>
          </div>
          <div className="create-post-user-info">
            <div className="create-post-username-wrapper">
              <span className="create-post-username">K-Pop Fan</span>
              <span className="create-post-verified">
                <i className="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="create-post-privacy-selector">
              <button className="create-post-privacy-btn">
                <i className={getPrivacyIcon()}></i>
                <span>{getPrivacyLabel()}</span>
                <i className="fas fa-chevron-down"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TEXTAREA */}
        <div className="create-post-textarea-wrapper">
          <textarea
            ref={textareaRef}
            className="create-post-textarea"
            placeholder="What's happening in K-Pop? Share your thoughts, news, or fan content..."
            value={content}
            onChange={handleContentChange}
            rows={6}
            autoFocus
          />
          <div className="create-post-character-count">
            <span className={characterCount > maxChars * 0.9 ? 'warning' : ''}>
              {characterCount}/{maxChars}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* IMAGE PREVIEW */}
        {image && (
          <div className="create-post-image-container">
            <div className="create-post-image-wrapper">
              <img src={image} alt="Preview" />
              <button className="create-post-image-remove" onClick={handleRemoveImage}>
                <i className="fas fa-times"></i>
              </button>
              <div className="create-post-image-overlay">
                <span><i className="fas fa-edit"></i> Edit</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* UPLOADING INDICATOR */}
        {isUploading && (
          <div className="create-post-uploading">

            <span>Uploading image...</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TOOLBAR */}
        <div className="create-post-toolbar">

              <i className="fas fa-image"></i>

            </button>

            />

              <i className="fas fa-video"></i>

              <span>Music</span>

              <i className="fas fa-hashtag"></i>

interface Comment {
  id: number;

  text: string;
  time: string;
}

interface Story {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  avatar: string;
  group: string;
  content?: string;
  image?: string;
  timestamp: string;
  audience: 'public' | 'friends' | 'private';

}

// ============================================================
// AVATAR
// ============================================================
const Avatar: React.FC<{ name: string; size?: number; hasStory?: boolean }> = ({ name, size = 44, hasStory = false }) => {
  const colors = ['#C084FC', '#EC4899', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22', '#FF6B9D'];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) {
    hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  const color = colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
  const initial = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <div 
      className={`avatar ${hasStory ? 'avatar-story' : ''}`}
      style={{ 
        width: size, 
        height: size, 
        background: color,
        fontSize: size * 0.4,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        color: 'white',
        fontWeight: 700,
        border: hasStory ? '3px solid #C084FC' : 'none',
        flexShrink: 0,
        transition: 'transform 0.2s ease'
      }}
    >
      {initial}
    </div>
  );
};

// ============================================================
// STORY AVATAR
// ============================================================
interface StoryAvatarProps {
  story: Story;
  onClick: () => void;
}

const StoryAvatar: React.FC<StoryAvatarProps> = ({ story, onClick }) => {
  const colors = ['#C084FC', '#EC4899', '#4A90D9', '#00B894', '#FDCB6E', '#E17055', '#74B9FF', '#2ECC71', '#E67E22', '#FF6B9D'];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < story.author.length; i++) {
    hash = story.author.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  const color = colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];

  return (
    <div className="story-avatar-item" onClick={onClick}>
      <div className={`story-ring ${story.isViewed ? 'viewed' : ''}`}>
        <div 
          className="story-avatar-img"
          style={{ 
            background: color,
            backgroundImage: story.image ? `url(${story.image})` : 'none',
            backgroundSize: 'cover',
            backgroundPosition: 'center'
          }}
        >
          {!story.image && story.avatar}
        </div>
        {!story.isViewed && <div className="story-live-dot"></div>}
      </div>
      <span className="story-avatar-name">{story.author}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/Notifications.css';

const Notifications: React.FC = () => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'unread' | 'mentions'>('all');

  const notifications = [
    { id: 1, type: 'like', user: 'ARMY_Leader', content: 'liked your post', target: 'BTS 10th Anniversary', time: '2 min ago', read: false },
    { id: 2, type: 'comment', user: 'BLINK_Captain', content: 'commented on your post', target: 'BLACKPINK World Tour', time: '15 min ago', read: false },
    { id: 3, type: 'follow', user: 'TWICE_Artist', content: 'started following you', time: '1 hour ago', read: false },
    { id: 4, type: 'mention', user: 'MOA_Helper', content: 'mentioned you in a comment', target: 'TXT New Album', time: '3 hours ago', read: true },
    { id: 5, type: 'follow', user: 'NCTzen_Official', content: 'started following you', time: '5 hours ago', read: true },
    { id: 6, type: 'like', user: 'STAY_Forever', content: 'liked your post', target: 'Stray Kids Award', time: '6 hours ago', read: true },
  ];

  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch(type) {
      case 'like': return 'fa-heart';
      case 'comment': return 'fa-comment';
      case 'follow': return 'fa-user-plus';
      case 'mention': return 'fa-at';
      default: return 'fa-bell';
    }
  };

  const getColor = (type: string) => {
    switch(type) {
      case 'like': return '#FF6B9D';
      case 'comment': return '#4A90D9';
      case 'follow': return '#00B894';
      case 'mention': return '#FDCB6E';
      default: return '#7A7A9A';
    }
  };

  const filteredNotifications = notifications.filter(notif => {
    if (filter === 'all') return true;
    if (filter === 'unread') return !notif.read;
    if (filter === 'mentions') return notif.type === 'mention';
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="notifications-page">
      <div className="notifications-header">
        <h2 className="notifications-title">
          <i className="fas fa-bell"></i> Notifications
        </h2>
        <div className="notifications-filters">
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('all')}>All</button>
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'unread' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('unread')}>Unread</button>
          <button className={`filter-btn ${filter === 'mentions' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFilter('mentions')}>Mentions</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notifications-list">
        {filteredNotifications.length > 0 ? (
          filteredNotifications.map((notif) => (
            <div key={notif.id} className={`notification-item ${notif.read ? 'read' : 'unread'}`}>
              <div className="notification-icon" style={{ background: getColor(notif.type) }}>
                <i className={`fas ${getIcon(notif.type)}`}></i>
              </div>
              <div className="notification-content">
                <div className="notification-user">
                  <span className="notification-username">{notif.user}</span>
                  <span className="notification-action">{notif.content}</span>
                </div>
                {notif.target && <span className="notification-target">{notif.target}</span>}
                <span className="notification-time">{notif.time}</span>
              </div>
              {!notif.read && <div className="notification-dot"></div>}
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="notifications-empty">
            <i className="fas fa-bell-slash"></i>
            <h3>No notifications</h3>
            <p>You're all caught up!</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Notifications;

const PostDetails: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [liked, setLiked] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [reposted, setReposted] = useState(false);
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [commentText, setCommentText] = useState('');
  const [post, setPost] = useState<Post | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Hita ny post mifanaraka amin'ny id
    const found = mockPosts.find(p => p.id === Number(id));
    setPost(found || null);
  }, [id]);

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const diff = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime();
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
    const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'Just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const formatNumber = (num: number) => {
    if (num >= 1000000) return (num / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (num >= 1000) return (num / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return num.toString();
  };

  const handleLike = () => {
    setLiked(!liked);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    setSaved(!saved);
  };

  const handleRepost = () => {
    setReposted(!reposted);
  };

  const handleShare = () => {
    alert('Lien copiÃ© dans le presse-papier !');
  };

  const handleAddComment = () => {
    if (commentText.trim()) {
      alert(`Commentaire ajoutÃ©: ${commentText}`);
      setCommentText('');
    }
  };

  if (!post) {
    return (
      <div className="post-details-page">
        <div className="post-details-header">
          <button className="back-btn" onClick={() => navigate(-1)}>
            <i className="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
          </button>
          <span className="post-details-title">Post not found</span>
        </div>
        <div className="post-details-error">
          <i className="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
          <p>This post does not exist.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="post-details-page">
      {/* HEADER AVEC RETOUR */}
      <div className="post-details-header">
        <button className="back-btn" onClick={() => navigate(-1)}>
          <i className="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
        </button>
        <span className="post-details-title">Post</span>
        <button className="post-details-more">
          <i className="fas fa-ellipsis-h"></i>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* CONTENU DU POST */}
      <div className="post-details-content">
        <div className="post-details-card">
          {/* HEADER */}
          <div className="post-details-header-info">
            <div className="post-details-avatar">
              <span>{post.avatar}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="post-details-author">
              <div className="post-details-name">
                {post.author}
                {post.verified && <span className="verification-badge">âœ“</span>}
                <span className="post-details-group">Â· {post.group}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="post-details-meta">
                <span>{formatTimeAgo(post.timestamp)}</span>
                <span>Â· <i className="fas fa-globe"></i></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* CONTENU */}
          <p className="post-details-text">{post.content}</p>

          {/* IMAGE */}

          )}

              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* STATS */}
          <div className="post-details-stats">
            <span>
              <i className="fas fa-heart" style={{ color: liked ? '#EC4899' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)' }}></i>
              {formatNumber(liked ? post.likes + 1 : post.likes)}
            </span>
            <span>
              <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
              {formatNumber(post.comments)}
            </span>
            <span>

              {formatNumber(reposted ? post.reposts + 1 : post.reposts)}
            </span>
            <span>
              <i className="fas fa-share"></i>
              {formatNumber(post.shares)}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* ACTIONS */}
          <div className="post-details-actions">
            <button className={`post-details-action ${liked ? 'liked' : ''}`} onClick={handleLike}>
              <i className="fas fa-heart"></i>
              <span>Like</span>
            </button>
            <button className="post-details-action" onClick={() => setShowComments(!showComments)}>
              <i className="fas fa-comment"></i>
              <span>Comment</span>
            </button>
            <button className={`post-details-action ${reposted ? 'reposted' : ''}`} onClick={handleRepost}>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="comment-input"
                  placeholder="Write a comment..."
                  value={commentText}
                  onChange={(e) => setCommentText(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAddComment()}
                />
                <button className="comment-send-btn" onClick={handleAddComment} disabled={!commentText.trim()}>
                  <i className="fas fa-paper-plane"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="comments-list">

                {post.commentsList.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="comments-empty">
                    <i className="fas fa-comment-slash"></i>
                    <span>No comments yet</span>
                  </div>
                )}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import '../styles/Search.css';

const Search: React.FC = () => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('all');

  const tabs = ['all', 'users', 'artists', 'posts', 'hashtags'];

  return (
    <div className="search-page">
      <div className="search-header">
        <div className="search-input-wrapper">
          <i className="fas fa-search"></i>
          <input
            type="text"
            className="search-input"
            placeholder="Search K-Pop..."
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
          />
          {query && (
            <button className="search-clear" onClick={() => setQuery('')}>
              <i className="fas fa-times-circle"></i>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="search-tabs">
        {tabs.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab}
            className={`search-tab ${activeTab === tab ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
          >
            {tab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + tab.slice(1)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="search-results">
        {query ? (
          <div className="search-empty">
            <i className="fas fa-search"></i>
            <p>Search results for "{query}"</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="search-trending">
            <h3>Trending Hashtags</h3>
            <div className="trending-hashtags">
              <span className="hashtag-chip">#BTS</span>
              <span className="hashtag-chip">#BLACKPINK</span>
              <span className="hashtag-chip">#NewJeans</span>
              <span className="hashtag-chip">#StrayKids</span>

              <span className="hashtag-chip">#Jimin</span>

              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="trending-trend">
              {topic.trend === 'up' && <i className="fas fa-arrow-up" style={{ color: '#4CAF50' }}></i>}
              {topic.trend === 'down' && <i className="fas fa-arrow-down" style={{ color: '#f44336' }}></i>}
              {topic.trend === 'stable' && <i className="fas fa-minus" style={{ color: '#FFD700' }}></i>}
            </div>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* FOOTER */}
      <div className="app-footer">
        <p>Â© 2026 K-Pop United. All rights reserved.</p>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../styles/Videos.css';

interface Video {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  thumbnail: string;
  channel: string;
  channelAvatar: string;
  views: number;
  timestamp: string;
  duration: string;
  category: string;
  isNew: boolean;
}

const Videos: React.FC = () => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<string>('all');

  const [videos] = useState<Video[]>([

    { id: 8, title: 'SEVENTEEN - "HOT" Performance (2026 Ver.)', thumbnail: 'https://picsum.photos/seed/svt-performance/400/225', channel: 'SEVENTEEN Official', channelAvatar: 'https://picsum.photos/seed/svt-channel/40/40', views: 2100000, timestamp: '4 days ago', duration: '3:50', category: 'Live Performance', isNew: false },
    { id: 9, title: 'IVE - "I AM" Dance Cover by Professionals', thumbnail: 'https://picsum.photos/seed/ive-cover/400/225', channel: 'K-Pop Dance World', channelAvatar: 'https://picsum.photos/seed/kdance-channel/40/40', views: 780000, timestamp: '8 days ago', duration: '3:25', category: 'Cover', isNew: false },
  ]);

  const categories = ['all', 'Music Video', 'Live Performance', 'Behind', 'Vlog', 'Dance Practice', 'Reaction', 'Cover', 'Music'];

  const filteredVideos = videos.filter(video => {
    const matchesSearch = video.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || video.channel.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || video.category === activeCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const formatViews = (views: number) => {
    if (views >= 10000000) return (views / 10000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (views >= 1000000) return (views / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
    if (views >= 1000) return (views / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
    return views.toString();
  };

  return (
    <div className="videos-page">
      {/* HEADER STICKY */}
      <div className="videos-header-sticky">
        <div className="videos-header">
          <h2 className="videos-title">
            <i className="fas fa-video" style={{ color: '#FF4500' }}></i> Videos
          </h2>
          <div className="videos-search">
            <i className="fas fa-search"></i>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search videos, channels..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CATEGORIES */}
      <div className="videos-categories">
        {categories.map((category) => (
          <button
            key={category}
            className={`category-btn ${activeCategory === category ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
          >
            {category === 'all' ? 'All' : category}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* GRID */}
      <div className="videos-grid">
        {filteredVideos.length > 0 ? (
          filteredVideos.map((video) => (
            <div key={video.id} className="video-card">
              <Link to={`/videos/${video.id}`} className="video-thumbnail">
                <img src={video.thumbnail} alt={video.title} />
                <span className="video-duration">{video.duration}</span>
                {video.isNew && <span className="video-new-badge">NEW</span>}
              </Link>
              <div className="video-info">
                <Link to={`/videos/${video.id}`} className="video-title">{video.title}</Link>
                <div className="video-channel">
                  <img src={video.channelAvatar} alt={video.channel} className="channel-avatar" />
                  <span className="channel-name">{video.channel}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="video-meta">
                  <span className="video-views">{formatViews(video.views)} views</span>
                  <span className="video-timestamp">â€¢ {video.timestamp}</span>
                </div>
                <span className="video-category-tag">{video.category}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="videos-empty">
            <i className="fas fa-video"></i>
            <h3>No videos found</h3>
            <p>Try adjusting your search or filters</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* FOOTER */}
      <div className="app-footer">
        <p>Â© 2026 K-Pop United. All rights reserved.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Videos;

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js
export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://github.com/Rel1cx/eslint-react/tree/main/packages/plugins/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import reactX from 'eslint-plugin-react-x'
import reactDom from 'eslint-plugin-react-dom'

export default defineConfig([
  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...
      // Enable lint rules for React
      reactX.configs['recommended-typescript'],
      // Enable lint rules for React DOM
      reactDom.configs.recommended,
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

===== C:\Users\ss\Documents\PRESENTATION\projet\src\App.tsx =====

import React from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import '@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css';

// Layout
import MainLayout from './layout/MainLayout';

// Pages
import Home from './pages/Home';
import Explore from './pages/Explore';
import Trending from './pages/Trending';
import News from './pages/News';
import Artists from './pages/Artists';
import Groups from './pages/Groups';
import Events from './pages/Events';
import Videos from './pages/Videos';
import Community from './pages/Community';
import Messages from './pages/Messages';
import Notifications from './pages/Notifications';
import Profile from './pages/Profile';
import Auth from './pages/Auth';
import CreatePost from './pages/CreatePost';
import PostDetails from './pages/PostDetails';
import Search from './pages/Search';
import Communities from './pages/Communities';
import Settings from './pages/Settings';
import Splash from './pages/Splash';

// Styles
import './styles/global.css';
import './styles/dark.css';
import './styles/MainLayout.css';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = React.useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    return saved ? saved === 'dark' : false;
  });

  React.useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
    localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
  }, [isDark]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setIsDark(!isDark);
  };

  return (
    <Router>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/auth" element={<Auth />} />
        <Route path="/" element={<MainLayout toggleTheme={toggleTheme} isDark={isDark} />}>
          <Route index element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="explore" element={<Explore />} />
          <Route path="trending" element={<Trending />} />
          <Route path="news" element={<News />} />
          <Route path="artists" element={<Artists />} />
          <Route path="groups" element={<Groups />} />
          <Route path="events" element={<Events />} />
          <Route path="videos" element={<Videos />} />
          <Route path="community" element={<Community />} />
          <Route path="messages" element={<Messages />} />
          <Route path="notifications" element={<Notifications />} />
          <Route path="profile" element={<Profile />} />
          <Route path="create" element={<CreatePost />} />
          <Route path="post/:id" element={<PostDetails />} />
          <Route path="search" element={<Search />} />
          <Route path="communities" element={<Communities />} />
          <Route path="settings" element={<Settings />} />
        </Route>
        <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
      </Routes>
    </Router>
  );
};

export default App;

// Layout

const App: React.FC = () => {

import React from 'react';
import Post from './Post';
import type { PostData } from './Post';
import '../styles/Feed.css';

interface FeedProps {
  posts: PostData[];
  onLike: (id: string) => void;
  onComment: (id: string) => void;
  onShare: (id: string) => void;
  loading?: boolean;
  emptyMessage?: string;
}

const Feed: React.FC<FeedProps> = ({
  posts,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onShare,
  loading = false,
  emptyMessage = 'No posts to display',
}) => {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-loading">
        <div className="feed-loading-spinner"></div>
        <p>Loading posts...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="feed-empty">
        <i className="fas fa-inbox"></i>
        <h3>{emptyMessage}</h3>
        <p>Check back later for updates from the K-Pop community!</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="feed">
      {posts.map(post => (
        <Post
          key={post.id}
          post={post}
          onLike={onLike}
          onComment={onComment}
          onShare={onShare}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Feed;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import Header from './Header';
import Sidebar from './Sidebar';
import RightSidebar from './RightSidebar';

interface LayoutProps {
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  isDark: boolean;
}

const Layout: React.FC<LayoutProps> = ({ toggleTheme, isDark }) => {
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();

  const toggleMobileMenu = () => {
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(!isMobileMenuOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = !isMobileMenuOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  };

  // RightSidebar tsy aseho afa-tsy ao amin'ny Home (/) ihany
  const showRightSidebar = location.pathname === '/';

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
  }, [location]);

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <Header 
        toggleTheme={toggleTheme} 
        isDark={isDark}
        onToggleMobileMenu={toggleMobileMenu}
        isMobileMenuOpen={isMobileMenuOpen}
      />
      <div className="app-body">
        <Sidebar isOpen={isMobileMenuOpen} onClose={toggleMobileMenu} />
        <main className="app-main">
          <div className="app-content-wrapper">
            <Outlet />
          </div>
        </main>
        {showRightSidebar && <RightSidebar />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Layout;

File: components\SearchBar.tsx
